data.other_hard: Must be nominated by a doctoral faculty member; students cannot nominate themselves; should be within two years of their estimated graduation date at the time of the nomination; must stay in the same program for the duration of the award; receiving a comparable fellowship or support from another company or institution (except for academic scholarships) during the funding period makes applicants ineligible
data.evidence_sentence: Students that are from U.S. embargoed countries or attending institutions located in U.S. embargoed countries are not eligible for the program.
data.notes: Page text describes the IBM PhD Fellowship Award; the name says Masters Fellowship Awards, which does not match the page. No application deadline stated. Award amounts: $40,000 for US universities, $6,000-$25,000 for universities in other countries; funding type set to partial based on fixed amounts. Host country not stated; depends on university. Nomination-based process, so enrollment_status set to enrolled and full-time from the requirement to be enrolled full-time in a PhD program. Text states 'should be within two years' of graduation as a preference-like wording but is listed under eligibility; kept in other_hard. Page text does not specify a GPA requirement.
